LangfuseProjectSettings.description: Credentials for a single Langfuse project for one component alias.

project_id.description: Optional project identifier override; empty means the public key scope.
project_id.title: Project Id

LangfuseProjectSettings.title: LangfuseProjectSettings

LangfuseSettings.description:
Canonical Langfuse observability block.

One project entry per LLM-facing component alias so the deployment
engine can enumerate and reconcile credential coverage.

projects.description: Map of component alias → project credentials.  Every component that emits LLM traffic must have an entry here keyed by the same alias used in ``openrouter.keys``.
projects.title: Projects

LangfuseSettings.title: LangfuseSettings

OpenRouterSettings.description:
Canonical OpenRouter credentials block.

One key per LLM-facing component alias, matching the aliases
declared in ``langfuse.projects``.

keys.description: Map of component alias → OpenRouter API key for that component.
keys.title: Keys

OpenRouterSettings.title: OpenRouterSettings

description:
Application settings loaded from ``config/config.json``.

Located via the ``ROBOTSIX_CONFIG_FILE`` environment variable (or
the default ``config/config.json``).  All values live in the config
file — no environment overlay, no CLI merge.

RADICALE_DEFAULT_CALENDAR.description: Default calendar name when no calendar_id is provided.
RADICALE_DEFAULT_CALENDAR.title: Radicale Default Calendar

CALDAV_TIMEOUT.description: Timeout in seconds for CalDAV HTTP requests.
CALDAV_TIMEOUT.title: Caldav Timeout

CALDAV_HEALTHCHECK_TIMEOUT.description: Timeout in seconds for the Docker HEALTHCHECK probe's CalDAV request. Keep this well under Docker's ``--timeout=10s`` so the probe exits before Docker kills it. Docker's own ``--retries`` and ``--interval`` provide transient-failure recovery across healthcheck invocations.
CALDAV_HEALTHCHECK_TIMEOUT.title: Caldav Healthcheck Timeout

langfuse.description: Langfuse observability credentials — host and per-alias project keys. Every component that emits LLM traffic must declare its projects here so the deployment engine can enumerate credential coverage.

openrouter.description: OpenRouter API credentials — per-alias keys. Every component that emits LLM traffic must have an entry whose alias matches the corresponding ``langfuse.projects`` key.

LOG_LEVEL.description: Log level - one of DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL.
LOG_LEVEL.title: Log Level

JSON_LOGS.description: When True, emit logs as JSON for structured-log ingestion.
JSON_LOGS.title: Json Logs
